responsibility: Implements the legacy Value Range Propagation support layer that stores SSA-name lattices as value_range_equiv objects and uses them to simplify GIMPLE. This file creates and maintains per-SSA range entries, consults global range queries and default-definition facts, exposes range_of_expr/value_of_* queries, and contains simplify_using_ranges transformations for conditions, switches, arithmetic, conversions, bit operations, abs/min/max, division/modulo, and selected internal calls. It is the operational engine behind vr-values.h, combining VRP lattice management with range-driven statement rewriting.
same_name_distinction: Implements the range-query and GIMPLE-simplification logic declared in gcc/vr-values.h, using value_range_equiv objects to maintain legacy VRP lattices and perform range-driven rewrites, rather than just exposing the simplify_using_ranges and vr_values interfaces.
